posts.author: nevigovar
posts.body: Is it possible to somehow disable this plugin in the middle of the game? I have a clear mini-game where you have to stand exactly on the squares only at a certain point in the game. The rest of the time we use this plugin and we walk outside the cages. How can I disable it only temporarily?

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body: The plugin overrides many core functions, it doesn't look easy to (temporarily) undo those changes. Asking the author to implement such a feature is probably the best you can do - because anyone else would first have to learn the whole plugin
